subtitle: How GCS secured Portuguese residency for a UAE-based family in under 14 months.
clientQuote: GCS made what felt overwhelming feel entirely manageable. We had our residency cards in hand within 14 months — our family finally has the security we were looking for.
challengeHeading: Seeking European Security for the Whole Family
challengeBody1: The Al-Rashid family had built a successful business in Dubai over two decades. With their children approaching university age, they wanted to secure EU residency — providing mobility, stability, and access to European education.
challengeBody2: They had explored several programmes independently but found the document requirements and local legal nuances difficult to navigate without expert guidance on the ground in Portugal.
solutionHeading: A Fully Managed Investment Fund Application
solutionBody1: GCS recommended the investment fund route — €250,000 into a regulated Portuguese fund — as the most straightforward path given the family's profile and timeline. Our team in Lisbon and Dubai coordinated the entire process.
solutionBody2: A dedicated case manager handled all documentation, NIF registration, bank account opening, and AIMA submission — keeping the family informed at every stage without requiring them to travel more than twice.
step1Desc: GCS reviewed the family's profile and financial position, confirming eligibility and recommending the investment fund route.
step2Desc: Our legal team coordinated authentication, translation and NIF registration for all five family members.
step3Desc: The €250,000 investment was placed into a CMVM-regulated Portuguese fund within four weeks of engagement.
step4Desc: The completed application was submitted to AIMA. Biometric appointments were handled at the Portuguese consulate in Dubai.
